The **Fat Man** is a ranged weapon in *Fallout 76*.

The Fat Man is a portable launcher that propels Mini Nukes at distant targets in an arching trajectory. If the Fat Man has the MIRV Launcher mod, the Fat Man needs to be aimed such that the trajectory of the mini nuke reaches above the target, as opposed to aiming such that the Mini Nuke hits the target or adjacent ground. A MIRV Mini Nuke will split into four projectiles while in the air.
